access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-14 (T-3553) from the museum's open-access image and object record: a pale blue-green silk dress: a tall lace standing collar and lace yoke, cream lace motifs applied down the bodice and on the skirt, lace undersleeves at the wrist, the skirt gored to a full hem with rows of tucks and a band above it. A real garment, American, not of Chicago and not of anyone drawn in the town.
note: One of the T-3553 finery references (docs/RESEARCH/finery-3553/README.md): the coloured silk afternoon dress.
